name: Černovice (Pelhřimov District, Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist part bearing a red rose with yellow centre and a navy blue lower fly part bearing a yellow rose with red centre.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 15 July 1993 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
